body: Confirmed independently in https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/pull/31 with Node 26.13.1. Latest npm 12.2.2 still produces the same two advisory families / 21 propagated moderate findings. Updating the project's scanner tree to all latest versions gives zero project findings, but does not change the npm CLI's bundled glob/minimatch copies. The separate CLI audit is preserved in that PR as `dev/log/issues/30/pulls/31/raw/npm-cli-audit.json`; the requirement to audit all build tooling remains explicitly unfinished pending an upstream bundle rebuild. No stress payload was run.

Confirmed independently in https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-objects-codec/pull/87 on Node 26.13.1/npm 12.2.2 (2026-11-14). A root devDependency on the current official npm CLI lets us preserve and audit the complete package-manager bundle in a lockfile. `npm audit --package-lock-only --json` reports the same two advisory families / 21 propagated moderate findings, with bundled glob 13.0.6 and minimatch 10.2.5. Current registry releases are glob 14.0.6 and minimatch 11.0.8; ordinary consumer overrides do not replace the released CLI's bundled copies.

Minimal reproduction remains the package.json and commands in the opening report. No resource exhaustion payload is needed or was run. Our necessary handling is to retain the current official CLI and explicitly leave the “all tooling has zero advisories” acceptance criterion unfinished; the audit remains enforced. Suggested upstream fix: migrate npm's internal consumers to the patched APIs, refresh the bundled graph, and validate install/ci/pack/publish-dry-run before publishing the replacement CLI. We do not downgrade to npm 9 as suggested by the audit's automated fix and do not silently modify npm internals in place.
